title: Victoria Beckham invests £3 million in daughter Harper’s beauty brand
summary: Entrepreneur and Spice Girls star Victoria Beckham is supporting daughter Harper’s beauty venture as new filings reveal a £3 million investment into holding company H7B Ltd between 2024 to 2025
